challenges.title: Autumn 20k
challenges.rules:
Run 20k in total between 21 September and 18 October.
Every run recorded on Strava counts, any pace, any route.
You must be a member of the BTR Strava club and joined to this group challenge.
Finishers go into the prize draw. Winners drawn at random and posted here.
